title: Person: John
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

John

anchor.prefix:
poured in. Then replacing the jar in the locker he poured a little of the whisky into two glasses, added a little water and came back with them to the fireplace.

 —A thimbleful,
anchor.suffix:
, he said, just to whet your appetite.

 Mr Casey took the glass, drank, and placed it near him on the mantelpiece. Then he said:

 —Well, I can’t help thinking of our friend Chris
